name: Route 25 & Sea Cottage (Bill's Lab)
summary: The coastal eastern headland leading to Bill's Sea Cottage. Defeat the shoreline trainers, assist Bill in reversing his accidental Pokémon fusion, and receive the vital S.S. Ticket before tackling the Cerulean Gym.

items.name: S.S. Ticket
items.method: Gifted by Bill inside Sea Cottage after activating the cell separation system

items.name: TM43 (Secret Power)
items.method: Given by a trainer on the coastal bluff

navigation_notes: The S.S. Ticket unlocks entry to the luxury liner S.S. Anne docked in Vermilion City. Return to Cerulean City and enter the Gym once your party reaches Lv. 22-24.
